items.html: After the above-mentioned restriction and Parsa, there are many lights there in the place of the Chazeh, and their ascent there for Mayin Nukvin was beneficial. You will understand that from what is written regarding AVI, who were divided into two—Abba and Israel Saba, Bina and Tvuna. The educated one will understand that so it was here. This is so because the name AB of AK are the Mochin inside Galgalta, and the name SAG is from the Ozen down to the Tabur in its internality, not in the lights that come out, but rather the inner lights of AK themselves. Thus, AB, which is a male, which are its Mochin, made a coupling with the tastes of SAG, which are from the inner AHP, which are the roots for the lights and branches that come out, and these inner tastes of SAG are female, and they copulated together.
